description: opensync-rpi pods as GRE parents on adapter B (spec 8.6, 9; V54's pods-only shape): rpi-pod-mt7921u-6.6.1-v1 with a second radio. Adapter A (MT7921AU, the pod's 2.4 GHz radio) keeps the fronthaul home-ap-24; it runs one AP, so the 2.4 GHz radio's M2 set maps the fronthaul alone and its backhaul BSS has no slot there. Adapter B (MT7921AU, 5 GHz) carries the pod's uplink station bhaul-sta-50 (the pod's: it keeps the phy's MAC) and the parent AP b-ap-50 (EMOSA's), configured by that radio's own M2: its backhaul BSS is the parent AP, not Multi-AP, no bridge, hidden, its Inet row the pod's underlay. EMOSA writes no channel or ht_mode on adapter B, which follows the station (V54: VHT 80 MHz on 149/80; EMOSA reports it in the 20 MHz classes, a known gap in spec 9). The interface names are the ones 52_owm_prep creates on both adapters; b-ap-50's vif_radio_idx is 1, 52_owm_prep's order on the real Pis (bhaul-sta 0, b-ap 1), unique on adapter B's radio, whose other VIF is the pod's station at 0 (read on pi1, image 084736, 12 October). A pod on Ethernet only keeps rpi-pod-mt7921u-6.6.1-v1.
